transform: Only known local path prefixes and temporary directory paths are replaced with literal tokens. Original files remain unchanged. Original SHA fields inside copied records refer to pre-export bytes; use exported_sha256 here for public-file integrity.
limitations: Redacted assessment/request bodies cannot directly reproduce their original canonical hash; pre-export identity checks are separately attested.

No raw user prompt, assembled role prompt, reasoning, raw event stream, tool-output dump, credential or memory database is exported. Fixed synthetic task definitions and diagnostic prompt templates remain inspectable sources.
Diagnostic provider rejection text is retained as a bounded public error.
Audit harnesses retain normalized paths for inspection; use the portable replay script for new runs.
No live outcome is rewritten, dropped or promoted by normalization.
